items.title: Should You Buy HP Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?
items.summary: HP (HPQ) stock has run hard over the past six months, gaining about 78%, and it still trades roughly 8% below its 52-week high. The steadier story is the share count. HP retires a slice of its own stock every year, so earnings per share grow faster than profits do. The question is whether a rising memory bill breaks that.
